exact_geometric_setup.surface: Kc elliptic K3 over P1_t with section
exact_geometric_setup.named_input: geometric J2 represented by the CV Azumaya/corestriction construction
exact_geometric_setup.named_output: the genus-one torsor class xi_J2 in Sha(E/Qbar(t))

semantic_distinction.meaning: J2 has a fixed lift in the CV presentation module LcE
semantic_distinction.not_the_same_as: the Leray/Ogg-Shafarevich image of J2 in H1(Qbar(t),E)
semantic_distinction.reason: The presentation connecting homomorphism measures failure of a Galois-fixed lift in LcE; the Brauer-to-Sha edge measures the relative Picard/gluing torsor of the elliptic fibration.

required_materialization.open_cover: choose a cover of the smooth locus U subset P1_t on which the named J2 Brauer gerbe/Azumaya class admits local relative degree-zero Picard trivializations
required_materialization.local_objects: line-bundle or divisor-class trivializations L_i on the pulled-back elliptic fibers
required_materialization.overlap_data: D_ij=L_j-L_i in Pic0(E) on U_i cap U_j
required_materialization.named_J2_requirement: the local trivializations must be derived from the named CV Azumaya/corestriction class, not from an arbitrary 2-covering with matching support
